subject: [bug? report] A fatal problem occurs for calling library AHMbook after update unmarked

messages.author: 22bf21b80c216e48
messages.subject: [bug? report] A fatal problem occurs for calling library AHMbook after update unmarked
parts:
Hello group,

I currently have encountered a problem in R v.4.3.1, that is, when I run:
> library(AHMbook)
 R program will be aborted and keep closing. I will put the detail below.

  1. I can work on 'unmarked' 1.3.2 and 'AHMbook' 0.2.9 properly [from CRAN] without encountering any problems.
  2. Then, I install new 'unmarked' [update it directly via github, to the version 1.4.1] just to try to work with it.
  3. 'unmarked' can be work properly, but when I run library(AHMbook), R program is aborted. 

so that I cannot worked on 'AHMbook' anymore, I suspect that this problem might somehow influenced by 'unmarked' also.

PROBLEM: when running library(AHMbook), R is aborted and keep closing itself in both original R GUI, Rstudios, and Rstudios via Anaconda. This occurs only for 'AHMbook'. Other packages work properly.

WHAT I TRY: The problem still persists even though I try something below.
  • install, reinstall via R and root files of 'AHMbook'
  • install, reinstall via R and root files of 'unmarked', also try reverted it to the original 1.3.2 version, problem still persists
  • check out for the package dependency via sessionInfo(), no dependency problem alerted

So that I put it here in 'unmarked' group as to report these strange issues.

Best regards
Pakorn
